name: Young Actors Summer Institute (YASI)
description_short: Trinity Rep runs one-week summer theater camps, and each week covers a different theater topic. They are for students from first grade through recent high school graduates. Families can sign up for one week or combine several.
activities: Stage combat and stage make-up (YASI Fight & Make-Up)
refund_policy_summary: A $50 non-refundable deposit is required to hold a spot. The full Cancellation Policy is on a separate page that this page links to. If you register without your financial aid discount code, the registration is cancelled and credit card fees are not refunded.
